dimensionScores.evidence: captureFullPageScreenshot wraps ONLY the enable/disable pair (not the whole withDebuggerSession callback): enable before the try, screenshotTab({captureBeyondViewport:true}) inside the try, finally unconditionally sends setFocusEmulationEnabled({enabled:false}) with .catch(()=>{}). Independent of withDebuggerSession's detach-only finally; defeat failureExample 1 and 2. Exit paths each pinned by a distinct test (capture-throws, disable-rejects, enable-fails, re-attach). No deterministic path leaks focus emulation.

Happy-path test asserts full ordered command-object list with exact params via toEqual([enable{enabled:true}, capture{format:'png',captureBeyondViewport:true}, disable{enabled:false}]), so it is red on removal OR reorder OR a synthesized clip. Throw-case test stubs capture to reject and asserts method order still [enable, capture, disable].

CaptureScreenshotOptions has new optional captureBeyondViewport?: boolean; existing clip/scale field types untouched. screenshotTab's FIRST branch emits no clip and no scale-built clip; clip/scale/scale-clip branches unchanged and still exercised by page-actions unit tests. format:'png' explicit. Field is optional, so no parity-surface expansion.

grep -iE 'not offered|not supported|unsupported|deliberately not' over debugger-ports.ts returns NO_MATCHES. captureScreenshot JSDoc routes full-page to the dedicated port; new captureFullPageScreenshot has its OWN doc comment stating it enables focus emulation for one capture and disables it in a finally before detach; does not overclaim (discloses CDP has no top-level scale).

withDebuggerSession label union is 'capturing' | 'capturing-full-page' | 'evaluating' | 'scrolling'; captureFullPageScreenshot uses the distinct 'capturing-full-page' label. Signature has no any and no non-null assertion; tsc --noEmit exits 0. Disable is .catch(()=>{})-swallowed so the capture error propagates (proven by the rejects-disable-still-observes-capture-error test). No chrome.debugger call bypasses the attach/detach wrapper.
